Starting AION 2 and don't know where to begin? This AION 2 Ultimate Beginner Guide covers everything you should know before playing, including classes, character progression, gear, combat, PvE, PvP, important systems, leveling, and the biggest things the game doesn't explain clearly.

Whether you're completely new to AION 2 or coming from another MMORPG, this guide will help you understand the basics, avoid common mistakes, and know what to focus on as you progress through the game.
